compile_time_scope: untimed case wall of the case that compiled; fixtures and verification excluded

overhead.scope: case wall clock outside the timed region: fixtures, H2D, handles, plan initialization, validation, output destruction

reason: Public EagerSession lstsq invokes QR whose CUDA Q application uploads scalar operands internally; no public interface can hoist this input preparation out of standard operation timing.
session_policy: one entered session for initialization, calibration and samples
setup_policy: fixtures, H2D, handles, plan initialization and output validation outside timing
synchronization: CudaRuntime::synchronize; no D2H in timed region

traffic.basis: one read of every declared input array plus one write of every declared output array, sized from the suite shape and dtype; logical interface bytes only, so neither cache-resident operands nor intermediate allocations are represented

verification.reference: numpy/scipy double precision; all requested outputs
